- **Run:** Friday rotation, Hulu account and Hulu brand, Jan 01 – Dec 31 2024, Facebook Only: Completed Video Views, Table View.
- **Per post:** Organic Completed Views + Paid Completed Views equals Completed Views on 198 of 200 rendered posts, with 0 failures. The other 2 (ranks 91 and 154) show "–" on all three columns, so I skipped them.
- **Aggregate Sum row:** 117,484,684 + 6,179,903 = 123,664,587, which matches Completed Views exactly.
- **Not checked:** Only the top 200 of 820 posts render, so the other 620 weren't checked individually. The Sum row covers all 820.
- **Bugs:** The case had no open linked bugs and the pre-fetched greps found nothing for it. I filed no bugs.
